subtitle: Keep matrimonial discovery safe, honest, and respectful

truthful.title: Use truthful profile details
truthful.body: Use your real identity, current photos, accurate relationship status, and honest family, education, and profession details.

respect.title: Communicate respectfully
respect.body: Do not harass, threaten, pressure, shame, or send abusive messages. Matrimonial conversations should remain consent-based and family-safe.

privacy.title: Protect privacy
privacy.body: Do not share another member phone number, email, photos, address, documents, or chat screenshots without permission.

fraud.title: Avoid fraud and solicitation
fraud.body: Do not request money, promote outside services, impersonate anyone, or use MatchMate for commercial lead generation.

report.title: Report unsafe behavior
report.body: Use report and block actions when a profile looks fake, suspicious, abusive, or violates privacy expectations.
